thirdcross.configuration.title: ThirdCross: Third-Person Utilities
thirdcross.configuration.firstPersonCros: Choose how ThirdCross renders the crosshair in first-person view.
thirdcross.configuration.crosshairMode.t: Choose how ThirdCross renders the crosshair in third-person view.
thirdcross.configuration.staticCrosshair: Choose the centered crosshair style used by Static + Aim mode.
thirdcross.configuration.crosshairInBack: Show the crosshair while using the back-facing third-person camera.
thirdcross.configuration.skipBackPerspec: Skip the back-facing third-person camera when cycling views with F5.
thirdcross.configuration.aimSmoothing.to: Smooth movement of the Aim crosshair. Higher settings are smoother but respond more slowly.
thirdcross.configuration.distanceBasedAi: Scale the Aim crosshair based on the target's distance and the player's interaction range.
thirdcross.configuration.crosshairTint.t: Apply vanilla-style contextual tinting to single crosshair modes.
